top_signals.title: Regulator opens triple probe into Prax Group’s oil audits
top_signals.summary: The audit watchdog has launched three separate investigations into the auditing of the collapsed UK energy challenger Prax Group.  The Financial Reporting Council (FRC) opened probes into the financial oversight and audit of Prax’s parent company, State Oil, and will also examine Big Four KPMG’s audit of the fiscal years ended 28 February 2022 and [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
